QuestInfo.name: The Final Answer
QuestInfo.0: The Black Mage... The Transcendent who still remembers me. I suppose that my existence depends on his existence.
QuestInfo.1: The Black Mage asked whether I regretted my decision on that fateful day. Would I have made the same choice if I knew it would turn out like this?
QuestInfo.2: I will never regret my decision. My pain is nothing balanced against the fate of Maple World. And I know this... I must get stronger so that I can make my own choice when I inevitably face the Black Mage again!

0.0: I was prepared to sacrifice myself that day. If I could give my life to rid the world of the Black Mage, I would gladly do so.
0.1: Do I regret the decision I made? #rI did my duty#k. But I never thought about it beyond that.
0.2: If I knew the consequences... if I knew that I wouldn't belong anywhere and remain forgotten to everyone... If #rI could choose again#k... Could I make that same choice?

no.0: ...Yes. Absolutely. It was the Black Mage who chose poorly, because I still exist to fight him!

1.0: In the end, my fate is the same. I will be the force to rid the world of the Black Mage. No matter how long it takes, and no matter the cost!
1.1: I must get stronger for that day. THAT is my purpose. THAT is what I live for. What I CHOOSE to live for!
